title: Remote sensing-based landslide prediction and risk assessment using a hybrid CNN-LSTM deep learning model.
summary: CNN–LSTM combines spatial and temporal remote-sensing features; the Kerman Province inventory includes 719 verified landslide events and 719 sampled non-landslide points. Model is compared with traditional ML and standalone DL.
ai_technology: CNN–LSTM combines spatial and temporal remote-sensing features; the Kerman Province inventory includes 719 verified landslide events and 719 sampled non-landslide points. Model is compared with traditional ML and standalone DL.

evidence.tested: Independent test set and spatial overlay with historical landslide inventory are reported; regional susceptibility evidence, not operational event forecasting.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
